Morocco have canceled their friendly against Ghana.

Ghana just lost 2-4 to The Gambia which is ranked no. 116 in the FIFA Men's World Ranking. Ghana are ranked no. 65.

Morocco are ranked no. 5 in the world.

Morocco have only lost once in their last 40 games.

Nigeria 🇳🇬 lost 0-3 to Guinea Bissau 🇬🇼 away from home.

Ghana 🇬🇭 lost 2-4 to The Gambia 🇬🇲 at home.

Tunisia 🇹🇳 were held to a 2-2 draw by Botswana 🇧🇼 at home.

Burundi 🇧🇮 held Algeria 🇩🇿 to a 2-2 draw.

Big Upsets in the 2027 AFCON Qualifiers.
